sentences.text: Hmph. Luna claims the house was haunted, but the data from the bathroom suggests a much more mundane explanation.
Between 03:00 and 05:20, the humidity sensor registered a significant drop, observed at 41.9 % compared to the expected 49.6 %.
Since the sensor indicates the air was drying out, this drop was probably caused by ventilation or a change in the environmental conditions.
It is highly unlikely that a spectral disturbance would cause such a measurable change in humidity levels.
